name: malasada
author: sliverarmory, jm33-ng
comment: Convert a Linux ELF shared object into position-independent malasada shellcode
help: Wrap a Linux ELF shared object as malasada raw PIC: a stage0 loader plus the shared object, optionally aPLib-compressed. The converter source is editable, so the detection loop can change its ELF patching, stage0 selection, or compression when a Linux sandbox detects that surface.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Linux ELF shared object to convert (C2 local path)

parameters.name: call-export
parameters.description: Exported symbol the stage0 stub calls (the C agent exports main)

parameters.name: compress
parameters.description: aPLib-compress the shared object before embedding
